events.title: Rust & Reveal: Restoration Simulator – Gameplay Showcase
events.summary: Join us for a gameplay showcase of Rust & Reveal: Restoration Simulator. Discover discarded and forgotten items, clean them step by step, restore their value, and turn them into something worth selling. During the broadcast, you can see key parts of the gameplay loop, including:Searching for and collecting discarded itemsScraping, brushing, foaming, washing, and dryingRevealing hidden objects beneath layers of dirt and grimeManaging your inventoryDismantling items for materialsRunning your shopS

events.title: DevLog #2 - Creditors, the Junkman and the Shop Computer
events.summary: Welcome to our second developer log! In the first one, we ended our core loop with "Pay Debts!" This time we'll show you who those debts are owed to, where the raw materials from your dismantled items go, and what's waiting for you on the shop's computer.Creditors at the DoorWhen you take over the shop, you don't just inherit its shelves — you inherit its debts too. events.title: DevLog #1 - Welcome to Rust & Reveal!
events.summary: Welcome to our first developer log for Rust & Reveal: Restoration Simulator! In Rust & Reveal, everything starts with the things other people have thrown away. Search through the town's trash and try to collect potentially valuable items before the garbage truck arrives. But not everything you find has to share the same fate.
